newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Vietnam buys 135,000/T fuel, 72,000/T mogas for 3Q.
newsitem.headline: Vietnam buys 135,000/T fuel, 72,000/T mogas for 3Q.

text.p: State-owned Vietnam National Petroleum Import-Export Corp (Petrolimex) bought five 27,000-tonne cargoes of fuel oil and four 18,000-tonne cargoes of gasoline for third quarter deliveries, source said on Friday.
Petrolimex took all the cargoes from Singapore trader Hin Leong Trading at a premium of $7.80 per tonne to Singapore spot quotes, cost-and-freight Ho Chi Minh City basis.
Two cargoes will be delivered each in July and August and one in September. The cargoes are 170-centistoke, 3.0-percent sulphur fuel oil.
Petrolimex is negotiating for a sixth cargo, the source said.
In its last tender for second quarter delivery, Vietnam took five 26,000-tonne cargoes of fuel oil at between $8.00 and $9.00 per tonne premiums, c-and-f basis.

In its third quarter tender, Vietnam also bought 83-octane leaded gasoline of Russian origin at a 70-cents per barrel premium to Singapore spot naphtha quotes, c-and-f Ho Chi Minh City, Danang or Hongai.
Two cargoes were awarded to Singapore trader Kuo Oil International, and one cargo each to Mitsui and Daxin.
One cargo each will be delivered in July and September and two cargoes in August.
Sources said Petrolimex is in talks for two more gasoline cargoes of Russian origin, which they said were difficult to come by.
In its last tender, Vietnam took six 18,000-tonne gasoline cargoes at 80-cents premium to Singapore spot naphtha quotes, c-and-f basis.
